notes: Warmth is exceptional: 'her tiny fist curled around the edge of my jacket' and 'her favourite landscape is still the underside of my chin' are the kind of irreplaceable specifics that earn a 5. The arc is textbook — grey dawn / slow climb with pauses / fog-clearing revelation / summit rest / descent reflection — every paragraph earns its place. Russian reads with native fluency throughout; the one minor stumble is 'как капает со вчерашнего дождя с веток' (double 'с' is slightly clumsy; 'как стекает вчерашний дождь с веток' would flow better), keeping it just below a 5. Seven photo indices span 0–11 with good distribution and no duplicates, plausibly matching opening trail, ascent, fog, ridge reveal, summit cross, tea break, and descent beats.
